name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The classic 3x3 game. Two players alternate placing marks — X and O — racing to land three in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. A match is a best-of series: the first player to win the required number of games takes it. Simple rules, perfect information, pure tactics — block your opponent, fork two threats at once, and never miss a win.

phases.name: turn
phases.description: Players alternate placing one mark per turn.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A Tic-Tac-Toe player. Reads the 3x3 board and places one mark per turn.

properties.name: mark
properties.description: This player's mark: 'X' or 'O'. Assigned by seat order.

properties.name: games_won
properties.description: Number of games this player has won in the current match.

properties.name: foresight
properties.description: 0 = plays reactively move-to-move, 1 = calculates forks and traps several moves ahead.

actions.name: place_mark
actions.description: Place your mark on one empty square. REQUIRED: `cell` — a number 1-9 identifying the square (1=top-left, 2=top-middle, 3=top-right, 4=middle-left, 5=center, 6=middle-right, 7=bottom-left, 8=bottom-middle, 9=bottom-right). The square MUST appear in `legal_cells` from your perception. Do NOT set a target_id. If you pick an occupied or invalid square your mark is auto-placed on the first empty square.

agent_archetypes.name: Optimal Tactician
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays Tic-Tac-Toe perfectly. Always takes a winning move, always blocks the opponent's three-in-a-row, and sets up double-threat forks. Never loses a game it can draw.

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Attacker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hunts for the win above all else. Builds threats fast and looks for forks, but occasionally tunnel-visions and misses a block.

agent_archetypes.name: Cautious Defender
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Defense first. Always blocks the opponent's threats and plays solid, safe squares — happy to grind out a draw.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Tic-Tac-Toe is strictly 2 players (X and O).

runtime_parameters.name: wins_needed
runtime_parameters.label: Games to Win Match
runtime_parameters.description: Games a player must win to take the match. 1 = best of 1, 2 = best of 3, 3 = best of 5. Draws are replayed.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'lunchroom championship' or 'AI vs AI exhibition'.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player wins the required number of games.

termination_conditions.name: match_drawn
termination_conditions.description: End the match if the game cap is reached with no clear winner.
